versions.subject: Create file_event_win_uac_bypass_eventvwr.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Event Viewer\RecentViews'
filter:
    Level: 4
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: fix: removing Level based filter
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Event Viewer\RecentViews'
filter:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
condition: selection and not filter
